CustomField.description: For pledge payments, this is the *payment* date, not the pledge date (which lives on the parent commitment's `EffectiveStartDate`). Distinct from `FQS_Processed_Date__c` (when the org entered the gift).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The date the donor made this gift — check date, credit-card charge date, or the date the wire hit. Required when Status is Paid or Fully Refunded.
